review_description: My husband and I were very pleased to have come across Aidan Flanagan Electrical, who recently completed our installation.  Aidan and his team were fantastic in every way!.  We would highly recommend Aidan and his team to anybody who wishes to have any electrical work done.  Thank you Aidan and team.Robyn and IanCarseldine.

The friendly and knowledgable Aidan Flanagan team supplied a prompt and fantastic quote and successful installation of a 6.6kW solar system. 18 months later, the system started failing. Email notification of failure of the 9.6kW LG Chem Battery were ignored for 9 months. After contacting LG Chem Australia directly, Aidan eventually replied and organised the warranty replacement. Again, great service, many promises, but again to no avail. Very disappointing and sad that this seemingly great business is so deceiving with their after sales support and service.
Quote was excellent.Very punctual and great installer.We were making electricty within hours of installation.

Went to Aidans place he showed the panels he had installed he did a search of my roof profile he put the paper work into origin got o.k. back arrived at my place 8.30am the 24 panels was up and running at 11.0am. I would highly recommend Aidan and his workman.
I would recommend this company to any enquiry.
